name: Guest List
ability: You start knowing 3 characters that are not in play.
flavor: If your name isn't on it, you know Dave, and Dave isn't here.
firstNightReminder: Show the Guest List 3 character tokens that are not in play.

name: Cufflinks
ability: You start knowing the other Cufflinks. Each night*, if yours has died, you learn a good player. [+1 Cufflinks]
flavor: Always a matched pair. Lose one and you go looking for another.
firstNightReminder: Point to the other Cufflinks: mark them PAIRED.
otherNightReminder: If the PAIRED player has died, point to a living good player and move the marker to them.

name: Champagne Tower
ability: Each night until midnight (night 3), you learn a smaller group of players: first 4, then 3, then 2 at midnight. The Demon is always in the group.
flavor: Every tier smaller than the last, and everyone watching the top.
firstNightReminder: Point to 4 players, one of them the Demon.
otherNightReminder: If it is not yet past midnight, point to a smaller group that includes the Demon: 3 players, or 2 at midnight.

name: Bouncer
ability: Each night*, you learn if an evil player nominated today.
flavor: He doesn't remember names. He remembers who started it.
otherNightReminder: Nod if an evil player nominated today, shake your head if not.

name: Noisemaker
ability: Each night*, choose a player: you learn if they woke tonight.
flavor: Nobody within four blocks is getting any sleep.
otherNightReminder: The Noisemaker chooses a player: nod if that player woke tonight, shake your head if not.

name: Photographer
ability: Each night*, you learn how many evil players voted on today's last nomination.
flavor: Last shot of the night. Everyone thinks they looked fine.
otherNightReminder: Show how many evil players voted on today's last nomination. If there was no nomination, show 0.

name: Soda Siphon
ability: Each night*, if you did not vote today, choose a player: you learn if they are evil.
flavor: Just soda for me, thanks. I'd like to remember this.
otherNightReminder: If the Soda Siphon did not vote today, they choose a player: thumbs down if that player is evil, thumbs up if not.

name: Coat Hanger
ability: Each night*, choose a player (not yourself): they cannot die tonight, but they have no ability until dusk tomorrow.
flavor: Your things are perfectly safe. You just can't have them until later.
otherNightReminder: The Coat Hanger chooses a player: mark them CHECKED. They cannot die tonight and have no ability until dusk tomorrow.

name: Lipstick
ability: At midnight (night 3), choose a player: you each learn the other's character, and neither of you can die tonight.
flavor: Ten. Nine. Eight. Whoever is standing nearest. Good luck.
otherNightReminder: At midnight, the Lipstick chooses a player: mark them KISSED. Show each of them the other's character. Neither can die tonight.

name: Karaoke Machine
ability: Once per game, at night*, choose a dead player: if they are a Townsfolk, they regain their ability until dusk tomorrow.
flavor: One more song. There is always one more song.
otherNightReminder: The Karaoke Machine may choose a dead player. If they are a Townsfolk, mark them ENCORE: they act as if alive for their ability until dusk tomorrow.

name: Confetti Cannon
ability: Once per game, during the day after midnight (night 3), publicly choose 3 neighbouring players: if the Demon is one of them, the Demon dies. If not, you die.
flavor: Single use. Wide spread. Someone will be finding it in their hair until March.

name: Chauffeur
ability: You cannot be drunk or poisoned. Each night*, choose a player: you learn if they are drunk or poisoned.
flavor: One sparkling water, nine passengers, and a full account of what everybody said.
otherNightReminder: The Chauffeur chooses a player: nod if they are drunk or poisoned, shake your head if not.

name: Disco Ball
ability: The first time the Demon attacks you, you survive, and you learn an evil player.
flavor: Throw anything at it and it comes back in a thousand pieces.
otherNightReminder: If the Disco Ball was attacked by the Demon for the first time tonight, they survive: mark them DIMMED and point to an evil player.

name: Cracked Phone
ability: Each night*, you must choose a living player. Tomorrow, you must nominate them, or you might die.
flavor: You sent it. Now you have to stand by it.
otherNightReminder: The Cracked Phone chooses a living player: mark them SENT. If the Cracked Phone doesn't nominate them tomorrow, they might die at dusk.

name: Potted Fern
ability: At midnight (night 3), if no one has nominated you yet, you die.
flavor: In the corner since nine, waiting for anyone at all to notice.
otherNightReminder: At midnight, if nobody has nominated the Potted Fern, they die.

name: Dumbbell
ability: You do not know you are the Dumbbell. You think you are a Townsfolk, and your ability works until midnight (night 3). After that, you are drunk.
flavor: Bought on January 1st. Doorstop by the 19th.

name: Bar Tab
ability: If you are executed, the player who nominated you dies tonight.
flavor: Somebody has to settle up, and everybody just left.
otherNightReminder: If the Bar Tab was executed today, the player who nominated them dies.

name: Bartender
ability: Each night, choose a player: they are drunk until dusk tomorrow.
flavor: First one's on the house. So is the second. That was the trick.
firstNightReminder: The Bartender chooses a player: mark them DRUNK.
otherNightReminder: The Bartender chooses a player: mark them DRUNK.

name: Hourglass
ability: On your first night, choose night 2 or night 4: midnight happens on that night instead of night 3, for every ability. [-1 Outsider]
flavor: Somebody turned it over, and nobody in the room can say when.
firstNightReminder: The Hourglass chooses night 2 or night 4: midnight falls on that night for every ability.

name: Tequila Shot
ability: If you are executed, every player who voted for you is drunk until dusk tomorrow.
flavor: It seemed like a great idea at the time. Everyone agreed.

name: Hotel Key
ability: If the Demon is executed before midnight (night 3), you become the Demon.
flavor: The venue closed. The room number went around anyway.

name: Broken Bottle
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. After midnight (night 3), their living neighbours are also poisoned until dusk tomorrow.
flavor: It starts with one crack. By morning everyone nearby is feeling it.
otherNightReminder: The Broken Bottle chooses a player: they die. After midnight, mark their living neighbours POISONED until dusk tomorrow.

name: Firecracker
ability: Each night*, choose a player. Before midnight (night 3), they do not die yet. At midnight, every chosen player dies. After midnight, each player you choose dies. If 3 or more players die at midnight, evil wins.
flavor: Everyone is counting. Nobody asked what happens at zero.
otherNightReminder: The Firecracker chooses a player: mark them COUNTED. At midnight every COUNTED player dies, and evil wins if 3 or more players died at midnight. After midnight, the chosen player dies.

name: Taxi Driver
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they cannot die tonight, and they cannot vote tomorrow.
flavor: Home safe by one. Nobody remembers how, and nobody made it to brunch.
otherNightReminder: The Taxi Driver chooses a player: mark them DRIVEN HOME. They cannot die tonight and cannot vote tomorrow.

name: Party Crasher
ability: Each day, before nominations, you may publicly choose a player: they cannot be nominated today.
flavor: Nobody invited them. Somehow they are now in charge of the guest list.
